description: This Java class defines a factory for creating Kafka producer connections, specifically for use within the Eclipse Ditto project. It configures Kafka producers with string serializers and provides methods to obtain connection identifiers and new Kafka producer instances.

classes.name: DefaultKafkaConnectionFactory
classes.description: A final class implementing KafkaConnectionFactory, responsible for creating Kafka producer instances and managing connection identification within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultKafkaConnectionFactory using a provided Connection and KafkaConfig.

methods.name: connectionId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId of the associated Kafka connection.

methods.name: newProducer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Kafka producer configured with the stored properties and string serializers.
